name: Trisha
greetingText: You may not know how special you are to me, but my heart knows it well. Hope you have a very special birthday.
wishText: Hii, Madam Ji . I know you are a little angry with me.So I am sorry for previous texts.Today is a special day.You are getting better with age.I wanted to present you with stars for your birthday. But their shine can’t match yours. Keep shining always.I I never believed in love at first sight until I met you.I very much love you forever whether you love me or not .If you give me a chance, I will keep the smile intact on your face forever. Happy birthday! 🥳🎉🎈🎂
textInChatBox: Happy birthday Trisha! A special message is waiting for you... (Click Send)
text2: That's what I was going to do.
text4: I realised, I wanted to do something
outroText: Okay, now come back and tell me if you liked it.
replayText: Or click, if you want to watch it again.
